This weapon is equipped with an integrated under-barrel flare launcher. It fires bioferrite-fueled disruptor flares that illuminate the area and cause local psychic disruption.

This weapon features a stripped-down, under-barrel shotgun attachment. It provides the user with a secondary firing option specifically designed to breach doors or clear close-quarters threats without switching weapons.
These projectiles have been dipped in sticky, flammable tar and wrapped in cloth. They have a high chance of igniting the target upon impact.
The limbs of this weapon are incredibly stiff, storing massive amounts of kinetic energy. It takes much longer to draw or crank, but the projectile flies faster and hits harder.
The projectiles use soft, owl-down fletching that silences their flight. It generates almost no noise, preventing animals from fleeing when missed.
The projectiles are tipped with jagged, cruel hooks designed to tear flesh and get stuck in the wound. They cause immense pain and have higher stopping power.
This bow is strung with a flexible, slightly slacker string. It allows for rapid volley fire at the cost of range and armor penetration.
This weapon is designed to fire two projectiles simultaneously. It creates a hail of arrows but makes aiming at specific targets much more difficult.
The projectiles are tipped with heavy, flat weights instead of sharp points. They deal blunt trauma, cracking bones and causing bruising rather than bleeding wounds.

This weapon is modified with heavy pulleys, a windlass, or reinforced laminate limbs, effectively turning it into a portable ballista. It hits with devastating force, capable of piercing thick armor, but the weapon is incredibly heavy and agonizingly slow to aim.

The arrowheads are replaced with crude, volatile explosive charges. Upon impact, they detonate in a small radius, dealing significant damage to clusters of enemies. However, the heavy and unbalanced payload causes the projectile to tumble in flight, making accurate fire nearly impossible.

This bow uses a specifically waxed, low-friction string. It allows the archer to hold extra arrows in their draw hand and loose them in a blur of motion. The hasty release prevents a full draw, limiting the weapon's effective range.

This weapon replaces a standard mechanical firing pin or gas system with an electronic rail-assist powered by a massive capacitor. It eliminates the mechanical cycling time between shots almost entirely, but the capacitor takes a significantly long time to charge before the first shot can be fired.
This weapon features extended, super-conductive acceleration rails that launch projectiles at hypersonic velocities, drastically increasing range and armor penetration at the cost of cycle time.
The magnetic acceleration rails are coated in the crypto-particle cooling jacket, preventing the overheating common in charge weaponry and allowing for a much faster rate of fire.

The barrel is lined with micro-magnetic coils that adjust the projectile's trajectory in mid-air. This "smart bullet" system actively corrects aim error, granting perfect accuracy, but requires lighter, smaller projectiles to function.
This weapon is encased in a heavy, liquid-filled cooling jacket. It prevents overheating, allowing for much faster sustained fire, but drastically increases the weapon's weight.
This weapon features a heavy deployable bipod. It provides extreme stability and accuracy at long range, but the setup time nearly doubles the time it takes to aim.
This weapon has a modified feed mechanism designed to put as much lead in the air as possible. It doubles the number of shots per burst, but the violent vibration reduces accuracy significantly.

This weapon uses a modified short-travel bolt carrier that strictly limits burst length. It fires half as many shots per volley, but the mechanism resets twice as fast, allowing for extremely responsive engagement.
This weapon incorporates reverse-engineered mechanoid technology to fire heavy, blunt-force energy slugs that devastate structures and armor at the cost of range.
This weapon has been re-barreled to fire fin-stabilized acid-injector flechettes. These rounds cause horrific internal dissolution in organic targets but are useless against mechanoids.
This weapon bears defaced Imperial crests; equipping it in the presence of Imperial caravans or visitors will be recognized as treason, causing an immediate and severe drop in relations.
This weapon is strung for extreme parabolic arcing, allowing arrows to be lobbed over walls and obstacles to hit unseen targets, though it is impossible to aim precisely.
This weapon's action is tuned for occasional moments of perfect alignment, granting a chance for shots to bypass defenses and inflict significant bonus damage.

This weapon is cobbled together from mismatched parts with a faulty sear mechanism. It is wildly unpredictable; sometimes it fails to fire entirely, while other times it accidentally discharges a double-length burst.

This weapon is a relic from a bygone era, its internal stress fractures held together by mere luck. It functions normally for a limited time, but after a set number of shots, the mechanism will shatter completely and the weapon will be destroyed.
This weapon fires rounds coated in active cryptoparticles that induce a rapid stasis-freeze effect on impact.
This weapon is etched with shifting, non-euclidean glyphs that whisper to the wielder, continually draining their mental stability while equipped.
This weapon is fitted with a custom-molded, ergonomic handle wrapped in high-quality leather. It feels reassuringly secure in the hand, filling the user with a sense of pride and accomplishment.

This weapon is covered in crude, carved notches, each tallying a life taken by a previous owner. It seems there’s one, and nineteen more of them. The handle feels rough and disturbing to hold, filling the user with a sense of dread and guilt.
The spiral grooves inside this weapon's barrel have been worn smooth by overuse. It is significantly less accurate at all ranges.
The internal mechanism is filled with sand, dirt, or dried grease. It cycles sluggishly, significantly increasing the time between shots.
This weapon has been repaired using heavy, improper scrap metal components. It is cumbersome to carry and takes much longer to aim.

This weapon has been permanently modified to fire non-lethal blunt pellets for target practice. While it causes pain and bruising, it lacks the stopping power and penetration to be useful in a real firefight.
This weapon's internal mechanisms are loose and poorly fitted. It suffers from inconsistent cycling issues, meaning the cooldown duration is completely randomized after every single burst.
This weapon fires a rapid 3-round burst. The uncontrollable recoil limits the weapon's effective range and severely reduces accuracy at medium and long distances.
This weapon features an extended barrel that significantly increases range and accuracy. However, the added weight makes the weapon slower to aim.
This weapon fires spread-shot pellets instead of solid slugs. It provides a major accuracy boost at close range, but deals less damage and has zero armor penetration.

This weapon features a hinged frame that breaks open for rapid casing ejection. It reloads significantly faster than a standard model, but the mechanism makes the weapon fragile and prone to breaking.
This weapon fires ultra-dense uranium slugs, giving it immense armor-penetrating capabilities, though the heavy recoil increases the time between shots.
This weapon uses a linear bolt mechanism to drastically reduce cooldown time, though it compromises long-range stability.
Retrofitted with a pulse-charge rail system, this weapon fires a single, high-velocity energy bolt that drastically improves damage and armor penetration.
This weapon includes a secondary sight mounted at a 45-degree angle, allowing the sniper to effectively engage targets at close range without using the scope.
This weapon is fitted with extreme magnification optics that significantly extend effective range but render the weapon completely unable to target enemies within a large minimum radius.

This weapon has had non-essential metal drilled out to drastically reduce weight. It increases the user's movement speed, but the structural integrity is compromised, lowering the weapon's maximum durability.
This weapon features a reinforced, heavy stock designed for bludgeoning. It significantly increases melee damage and stun chance, but the added weight increases aiming time.
This weapon has gas vents drilled near the muzzle to counteract recoil. It reduces the cooldown time between shots, allowing for faster sustained fire, but slightly reduces maximum range.
This weapon is fitted with self-illuminating sights. It provides a consistent accuracy increase across all ranges, particularly useful in poor lighting conditions.
This weapon features a finely tuned, sensitive trigger mechanism. It improves accuracy at medium and long ranges, but requires a deliberate, gentle squeeze, which slightly increases aiming time.

This weapon has been modified to fire controlled, semi-automatic shots rather than fully automatic sprays. It fires fewer shots per burst, but gains a massive accuracy boost at medium and long ranges.

This weapon is paired with a matching duplicate, allowing the colonist to dual-wield. It doubles the number of rounds fired in a burst and doubles the fire rate, but aiming two weapons simultaneously significantly reduces accuracy.
